title: Изображения в стиле бренда
story: A row of frames settling onto one palette of four swatches, a crimson hairline locking the grid, each frame edge aligned to a shared reference point. No cameras, no faces.

title: Видеогенерация или студия
story: Two currents of light cross a dark hall: one assembles from drifting particles, one cast from a warm lamp, meeting in a single crimson thread at center
